meta.tldr: Omadesign got two big pull requests up for review: a hardening pass that fixes sub-pixel resize and rotated Transform sizing and turns the library test suite green, and a stacked follow-up that splits the Little CMS and LibRaw bridges into their own crates in a new Cargo workspace

shipped.title: Omadesign · hardening, sub-pixel resize, rotated Transform W/H
shipped.summary: Opened a pull request that closes three Omadesign issues: resize and Transform fields now accept sub-pixel sizes, the Transform panel edits a rotated object's own width and height without swapping them at 90 degrees, and a hardening pass cleans up unsafe code and speeds up builds.
bullets: Library tests go from 2101 passed and 58 failed on master to 2164 passed and 0 failed, with no new skips
A 0.25 px outlined stroke no longer snaps to 1 px
The aarch64 test relink dropped from 26 s to 13 s by linking with the bundled rust-lld

shipped.title: Omadesign · Cargo workspace with FFI bridge crates
shipped.summary: Opened a stacked follow-up that makes Omadesign a Cargo workspace and moves the Little CMS and LibRaw bindings into their own crates, so the app crate itself no longer contains any unsafe code.
